data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Deadlands and Stlican Lead Base Turnover
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the western arc remains the most volatile sector. Deadlands recorded four ownership flips in the past two hours and six in six, pushing its daily total to nineteen; Stlican Shelf added five turns in the last six hours for a running total of twenty‑nine. Weathered Expanse was quiet in the latest two‑hour window but has logged twenty‑four changes over the day. Godcrofts saw three fresh flips in six hours (thirteen total), while Kings Cage registered three in six (five total). Fishermans Row and Callahans Passage have had no flips in the last two hours but each accumulated seventeen and eleven changes respectively over the past day. Casualty streams surged sharply in the most recent hour on all active fronts; the two‑hour comparison shows cooling rates in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands, Godcrofts and Kings Cage, while Callahans Passage and Marban Hollow show accelerating losses. Enlistment rates rose sharply at Callahans Passage and Kings Cage, modestly at Marban Hollow, but fell across Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain static with no base turnovers.
